en: Use [W][A][S][D] or the arrow keys to move.
Walk into the box to push it. If you aren't facing it, the first press only turns you around.
zh-Hans: 走向箱子就能推动它。如果没有面朝箱子，第一下只会转身。

en: Push the box onto the goal to clear the level.
zh-Hans: 把箱子推到终点上就能过关。

en: This glowing box is a portal. Push it onto the pedestal.
zh-Hans: 这个发光的箱子是传送箱，把它推上底座。

en: Face the portal and press [F] to travel to the world of its color.
zh-Hans: 面朝传送箱按 [F]，就能前往它颜色对应的世界。

en: You are in Summer now. The panel at the top shows which world you are in.
zh-Hans: 你现在在夏天。屏幕上方的面板会显示你所在的世界。

en: Each world has its own walls. The hedge only grows in Spring, so the way is clear here.
zh-Hans: 每个世界都有自己的墙。树篱只长在春天，所以这里畅通无阻。

en: Every world shares the same wooden boxes. Push one here and it moves in all of them.
zh-Hans: 所有世界共用同一批木箱。在这里推动它，所有世界里的它都会跟着动。

en: You arrive where you stand. Enter from a different side of the pedestal to land somewhere else.
zh-Hans: 你站在哪里，就会落在哪里。从底座的另一侧进入，就会到达别的位置。

en: A return portal formed on your pedestal. Push it onto another pedestal to travel back from there.
zh-Hans: 你的底座上出现了回程传送箱。把它推到另一个底座上，就能从那里传送回去。

en: Summer is locked: a box is sitting where Summer has a wall, so its portal won't let you in.
zh-Hans: 夏天被锁住了：有箱子压在夏天的墙所在的格子上，所以传送箱进不去。

en: Push the box off that spot to unlock Summer.
zh-Hans: 把箱子推离那一格，就能解锁夏天。

en: Boxes can pass through other worlds' walls, but that world stays locked while a box is inside one.
zh-Hans: 箱子可以穿过其他世界的墙，但只要箱子压在墙上，那个世界就会一直被锁住。

en: {0} is locked: a box is sitting on one of its walls or portals. Move it away first.
zh-Hans: {0}被锁住了：有箱子压在它的墙或传送箱上。先把箱子推开。

en: That box is stuck in a corner. Press [Z] to undo.
zh-Hans: 这个箱子卡在墙角了。按 [Z] 撤销。

en: Stuck? Press [R] to start the level over.
zh-Hans: 卡住了？按 [R] 从头开始。

en: The portal you left behind was pulled over to your pedestal. When you travel, its partner always follows you.
zh-Hans: 你留在原地的传送箱被拉到了你所在的底座上。每次传送，配对的另一半都会跟着来到你身边。
